mapper.sql: I.SNC_IMP_SN AS impactSn, I.SNC_SN AS sanctionSn, I.SNC_IMP_REF_TYPE_CD AS referenceTypeCode, I.SNC_IMP_REF_SN AS referenceSn, I.SNC_IMP_ROLE_CD AS roleCode, I.SNC_IMP_ACTION_CD AS actionCode, I.SNC_IMP_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, I.SNC_IMP_PREV_STATUS_CD AS previousStatusCode, I.SNC_IMP_PREV_START_DT AS previousStartAt, I.SNC_IMP_PREV_DDLN_DT AS previousDeadlineAt, I.SNC_IMP_REMAIN_START_SEC AS remainingStartSeconds, I.SNC_IMP_REMAIN_SEC AS remainingSeconds, CASE WHEN I.SNC_IMP_STLM_HOLD_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS settlementHeld, I.SNC_IMP_RSLT_CN AS result, I.SNC_IMP_REG_DT AS registeredAt, I.SNC_IMP_UPDT_DT AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SANCTION_IMPACT ( SNC_SN, SNC_IMP_REF_TYPE_CD, SNC_IMP_REF_SN, SNC_IMP_ROLE_CD, SNC_IMP_ACTION_CD, SNC_IMP_STATUS_CD, SNC_IMP_PREV_STATUS_CD, SNC_IMP_PREV_START_DT, SNC_IMP_PREV_DDLN_DT, SNC_IMP_REMAIN_START_SEC, SNC_IMP_REMAIN_SEC, SNC_IMP_STLM_HOLD_YN, SNC_IMP_RSLT_CN, SNC_IMP_REG_ID, SNC_IMP_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{sanctionSn}, #{referenceTypeCode}, #{referenceSn}, #{roleCode}, #{actionCode}, #{statusCode}, #{previousStatusCode}, #{previousStartAt}, #{previousDeadlineAt}, #{remainingStartSeconds}, #{remainingSeconds}, CASE WHEN #{settlementHeld} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{result}, #{actorId}, #{actorId} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM SANCTION_IMPACT I WHERE I.SNC_SN = #{sanctionSn} ORDER BY I.SNC_IMP_REF_TYPE_CD, I.SNC_IMP_REF_SN, I.SNC_IMP_SN FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM SANCTION_IMPACT I JOIN SANCTION S ON S.SNC_SN = I.SNC_SN WHERE S.SNC_SRC_ABR_SN = #{reportSn} ORDER BY I.SNC_IMP_SN

SELECT FROM SANCTION_IMPACT I WHERE I.SNC_IMP_REF_TYPE_CD = #{referenceTypeCode} AND I.SNC_IMP_REF_SN = #{referenceSn} AND I.SNC_IMP_STATUS_CD IN ('ACTIVE', 'RELEASE_PENDING') ORDER BY I.SNC_IMP_SN FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM SANCTION_IMPACT I JOIN SANCTION S ON S.SNC_SN = I.SNC_SN WHERE S.USR_SN = #{userSn} AND S.SNC_SRC_ABR_SN IS NOT NULL AND S.SNC_END_DT IS NOT NULL AND I.SNC_IMP_ACTION_CD = 'PAUSED' AND I.SNC_IMP_STATUS_CD IN ('ACTIVE', 'RELEASE_PENDING') ORDER BY I.SNC_IMP_REF_TYPE_CD, I.SNC_IMP_REF_SN, I.SNC_IMP_SN FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE SANCTION_IMPACT SET SNC_IMP_STATUS_CD = #{statusCode}, SNC_IMP_RSLT_CN = #{result}, SNC_IMP_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, SNC_IMP_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SNC_IMP_SN = #{impactSn} AND SNC_IMP_STATUS_CD = #{expectedStatusCode}
